topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
response: Trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays. Larger arrays (e.g., 64x64) achieve higher gains (39.2 dBi) but lower efficiencies (41%). Smaller arrays (e.g., 16x16) have higher efficiencies (70%) but lower gains.
reference_context: SIW array size affects radiation efficiency, with larger arrays having lower efficiencies due to increased insertion loss, as seen in comparisons of 16x16 and 64x64 arrays.
